verdict.rationale: Pigment documents per-application edit histories down to the data-block level, which gives some versioning and visibility. It also offers testing environments where modellers stage changes before pushing them to production, which acts as a review step. Neither is described as applying to automations specifically, and no rollback or restore capability is documented. Missing for 10: explicit versioning of automations, review or approval workflow for automation changes, documented rollback or restore, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: your applications each have detailed histories down to the data block level, which offer full visibility into the edit events
testing environments that allow your modellers to plan and stage changes before being pushed into the production application.
